cwe_content.cwe: CWE-77,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')

candidate.Reason: The 'branch' parameter is directly passed as an argument to the hg command without proper sanitization, allowing command injection if an attacker controls the branch name
The 'repositoryURL' parameter is directly passed as an argument to the hg command without proper sanitization, potentially allowing command injection

candidate.Code: CommandLine hg = hg("pull", "-b", branch, "--config", String.format("paths.default=%s", url));
candidate.Reason: Both 'branch' and 'url' parameters are directly passed as arguments to the hg command without proper sanitization, allowing command injection if an attacker controls these values
The revision parameter (revision.getRevision()) is directly passed as an argument to the hg command without proper sanitization, potentially allowing command injection

candidate.Code: CommandLine hg = hg("log", "--limit", String.valueOf(count), "-b", branch, "--style", templatePath());
candidate.Reason: The 'branch' parameter is directly passed as an argument to the hg command without proper sanitization, allowing command injection if an attacker controls the branch name
Both the revision parameter (revision.getRevision()) and 'branch' parameter are directly concatenated/passed as arguments to the hg command without proper sanitization, allowing command injection
The 'url' field is used in the hg command construction and could potentially be manipulated to inject malicious commands
